description.subtitle: Adidas children's anthem jacket from the Spanish selection of the second gear 2026 - beige
description.intro: The Spanish adidas Originals children's anthem jacket combines the retro football air of the second outfit with a modern style designed for young fans who live football with passion. Its design recovers classic details to create an elegant and sporty look, perfect for both day to day and to encourage the selection.
key_benefits: Inspiration in the second team: Design that pays tribute to the Spanish football tradition.
Soft knit fabric: Comfort and resistance for daily use.
Classic cut: Comfortable fit that allows freedom of movement.
Full Zipper: Easy to put on and remove.
Trefoil logo and shield: Original identity with football character.
